subject: ist-s-algn
title: (R)IST.S.ALGN.------INFO.CON.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-27, second of two on book p171, paired with v2-p171-1. Continues the procedure argument by crossing a new subject (isolated systematic alignment) against information-convergence. (R)IST-S-ALGN (the reality of isolated systematic alignment) is crossed with INFO-CON (information convergence): the question is what isolated-systematic-alignment produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with information-convergence — the (R) prefix marking that real isolated-systematic-alignment is the only resource against information-convergence's pull. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) branches from the main line and carries AFN (affinity negation), which carries PRI-INFO (principle information) and (P)VT-PLT (vibrational platform, at the point of idea completion); EXTN-D (existential definition) branches from the (P)VT-PLT line. INFO-CON itself is partner. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) also branches from the main line; AFI(1) (affinity insight—first degree) branches from AF-DY, PR-TR from AFI(1), and EXT-DY (extended dynamics) from PR-TR.
